title: Diretor médico
description:
Diretor Médico (RJ)

Nosso cliente é um importante hospital de médio porte no Estado do Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades

Responsável por dirigir a área médica, zelando pela sua qualidade assistencial e sustentabilidade do hospital, o profissional terá como principais atribuições:

  • Garantir as entregas dos objetivos assistenciais e de gestão do hospital pertinentes à área médica;
  • Assegurar melhoria contínua dos processos assistenciais, buscando maiores níveis de qualidade na prestação dos serviços de saúde;
  • Buscar o crescimento sustentável do hospital;
  • Buscar oportunidades de novos serviços médicos;
  • Atuar fortemente junto à equipe médica, visando o maior engajamento e desenvolvimento dos seus profissionais;
  • Representar tecnicamente o hospital frente aos órgãos externos, zelando pela melhor reputação da empresa.

Qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Medicina, com MBA / pós graduação em gestão da saúde ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável ter cursado Residência Médica;
  • Experiência relevante na assistência, incluindo vivência no ambiente hospitalar (CTI, cirurgias, etc.);
  • Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência em cargos de gestão na saúde. Pelo menos 5 anos posições de liderança médica (entre coordenação, gerência e diretoria) em Ambiente Hospitalar;
  • Desejável participação efetiva em processos de certificação ou recertificação.

Principais Competências

  • Gestão de Qualidade Assistencial;
  • Comunicação eficaz;
  • Visão de Negócios;
  • Autonomia / motivação intrínseca para superação de desafios;
  • Gestão de pessoas.

Modelo de trabalho presencial. Disponibilidade para residir / atuar no Estado do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Digital Strategy Director
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose

The Director of Digital Strategy is responsible for contributing to the leadership, management, and overall success of the Digital Strategy team. This role oversees strategy and reporting for 5–7 clients, leading the planning and strategic execution of paid search, display, streaming, and paid social campaigns that are measurable, effective, and aligned with each client’s goals. The Director serves as a team leader, bringing innovative and thoughtful approaches to client success, reporting, and paid media strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Campaign Oversight
  • Maintain strategic oversight of 5–7 complex, holistic client accounts, owning the development, implementation, and optimization of digital strategy and paid media budgets across all channels, typically with annual budgets of $500k+.
  • Architect comprehensive digital strategies driven by clients’ marketing goals and objectives.
  • Oversee and verify that ongoing account maintenance and optimization activities align with campaign goals across all channels.
  • Client Interaction
  • Foster strong client–agency relationships through recurring strategy calls, acting as an expert partner who advises on best practices and strategic direction.
  • Play a supervisory role by overseeing Digital Strategists’ work on key clients, including participation in client calls.
  • Reporting and Analysis
  • Conduct research, analyze performance data, and translate findings into actionable insights and strategic recommendations—including budget adjustments and optimization strategies.
  • Provide in-depth monthly and ad‑hoc reporting using tools such as Google Analytics, Looker Studio, custom ROI dashboards, and platform reporting interfaces.
  • Ensure that all reporting clearly communicates campaign goals and effectively articulates key takeaways, recommendations, and next steps.
  • Continually evaluate the effectiveness and client experience of reporting and analysis to ensure they meet evolving client needs.
  • Team Management and Supervisory Responsibilities
  • Support leadership of the Digital Strategy team, with potential responsibility for directly managing 2‑3 team members.
  • Lead onboarding, training, and ongoing mentoring of direct reports, and contribute to the professional growth of team members across the department.
  • Internal Team Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with client account teams to manage relationships and ensure client success.
  • Partner with the sales team to strengthen and expand relationships with existing clients and support digital strategy development for prospective clients.
  • Promote cross‑divisional communication and collaboration to ensure a seamless internal workflow and client experience.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, emerging platforms, and industry developments.
  • Demonstrate thought leadership through contributions to team meetings, process improvements, and opportunities for service expansion.
  • Contribute to the Carnegie blog, webinars, workshops, and conference presentations, as appropriate.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline‑driven environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to confidently present campaign performance to clients and internal teams.
  • Proven problem‑solving skills, with the ability to work independently, use available resources effectively, and elevate issues when appropriate.
  • Effective communication and time management skills, particularly in a remote environment; ability to learn and switch between multiple technology platforms.
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods

Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Marketing / Advertising major or concentration preferred
  • 5–7 years of experience with paid digital platforms, media planning, and / or execution of digital marketing campaigns
  • Expertise in analyzing and reporting on data trends with a full understanding of digital marketing KPIs and success metrics
  • Experience using and analyzing data visualization tools such as Google Looker Studio and Google Analytics
  • Expertise and direct experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Campaign Manager, and Google Display & Video 360, or other DSP required
  • Google Ads and / or Google Analytics certifications a plus
  • Experience with Asana or other project management software tools a plus
  • Agency experience is a plus

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health / Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Responsibilities

Responsável por supervisionar, coordenar e orientar as equipes de vigilantes e vigilantes motociclistas, garantindo o cumprimento das rotinas de trabalho, normas de segurança e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa. Monitora e avalia as ações da equipe no controle de acesso, patrulhamento e demais atividades de segurança patrimonial.

Realiza treinamentos periódicos com os vigilantes, abordando temas como procedimentos operacionais, primeiros socorros e atuação em situações de risco ou emergência. Organiza e distribui as escalas de trabalho e turnos, conforme a necessidade dos postos de segurança e da carga horária da equipe.

Em situações de emergência, atua diretamente, adotando medidas imediatas e acionando as autoridades competentes, quando necessário. Também elabora relatórios diários e mensais das atividades realizadas, registrando incidentes, ocorrências e ações preventivas ou corretivas.

Garante que todos os equipamentos de segurança — como câmeras, rádios e coletes — estejam funcionando corretamente e sejam distribuídos adequadamente entre os membros da equipe. Realiza inspeções diárias nos postos de serviço para verificar o cumprimento das normas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

Atua como elo entre os vigilantes e a administração da empresa, assegurando que as demandas operacionais sejam atendidas com eficiência. Quando necessário, aplica medidas disciplinares conforme as diretrizes internas, mantendo a ordem e o bom desempenho da equipe.

  • Curso de Supervisor de Segurança (desejável).
  • Certificado de Vigilante válido, emitido por órgão competente.
  • Atuação comprovada na área de segurança patrimonial.
  • Vivência em cargos de liderança ou supervisão de equipes de segurança.
  • Desejável experiência em gestão de segurança em grandes empresas ou ambientes de alto risco.
  • Capacidade de supervisionar, coordenar e motivar equipes de vigilantes.
  • Conhecimento das rotinas de segurança patrimonial, controle de acesso, CFTV, alarmes e protocolos de emergência.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza e assertividade no relacionamento com equipe, superiores e clientes.
  • Proatividade, responsabilidade e tomada de decisão rápida em situações de risco ou emergência.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e lidar com situações de estresse com equilíbrio.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos, inclusive finais de semana e feriados, conforme necessidade da operação.
  • Habilidade com sistemas de gestão de segurança e elaboração de relatórios operacionais.

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Descrição da empresa

Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso!

Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito.

Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Descrição da vaga

Você será responsável por operar equipamentos e instalações da área de filtragem, tais como: espessador, clarificador, planta de filtragem, filtros cerâmicos e estação de tratamento de água e outros equipamentos assemelhados, em local remoto ou automático, para operacionalização do sistema de filtragem.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

  • Operar os equipamentos da área de filtragem, painéis de comando, sistemas de comunicação e centrais de controle;
  • Inspecionar in loco as áreas do terminal do mineroduto, espessamento, tanques de homogeneização e filtragem, verificar e utilizar o equipamentos para identificar vazão, densidade, pressão e outros;
  • Inspecionar in loco as bombas, válvulas e instrumentos (fluxostato, pressostato, manômetro) do espessamento e identificar o bom funcionamento;

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data‑driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast‑moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You’ll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data‑driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands‑on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end‑to‑end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.

Qualifications

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

description:
Job Overview

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement.
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus.
  • Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it’s built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

Sobre Nós

A Emagrecentro é referência em tratamentos para emagrecimento saudável e bem-estar, ajudando milhares de pacientes a reencontrarem sua autoestima e qualidade de vida. Nossa missão é transformar vidas através de um método inteligentes e humanizado. Estamos em um momento de forte expansão digital e buscamos uma pessoa comunicativa, empática e orientada a resultados para ser a linha de frente do nosso atendimento online.

Como SDR/CRC, telemarketing

Você será o primeiro ponto de contato (e o mais importante!) com nossos potenciais clientes que chegam através dos canais digitais. Seu principal objetivo será transformar o interesse desses leads em agendamentos qualificados para nossa equipe de avaliação. Você não irá vender o tratamento, mas sim "vender" a importância do primeiro passo: o agendamento da consulta.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gestão de Leads (Inbound): Recepcionar e gerenciar com agilidade todos os leads gerados via WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger e formulários do site.
  • Qualificação e Agendamento: Realizar o primeiro atendimento de forma consultiva e humanizada. Entender as dores, necessidades e o momento do lead, quebrando objeções iniciais ("é caro?" ou "não tenho tempo").
  • Foco na Conversão: Conduzir a conversa com foco total no agendamento da avaliação inicial (online ou presencial).
  • Follow-up Estratégico: Realizar o acompanhamento (follow-up) dos leads que demonstraram interesse, mas não agendaram de imediato, mantendo o relacionamento aquecido.
  • Uso de Ferramentas: Alimentar e organizar o CRM (Software de Gestão de Clientes) com todas as informações e interações dos leads.
  • Gestão de Agenda: Otimizar a agenda dos nossos especialistas, garantindo o preenchimento dos horários e gerenciando confirmações de consulta.

Requisitos Essenciais para a Vaga

  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de escrita impecável (português correto, clareza, tom de voz adequado) e excelente comunicação verbal.
  • Empatia e Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de se conectar genuinamente com o lead. O tema (emagrecimento) pode ser sensível, e precisamos de alguém que saiba acolher antes de agendar.
  • Agilidade Digital: Rapidez para responder e gerenciar múltiplos canais de atendimento simultaneamente (especialmente WhatsApp Business).
  • Organização e Foco: Ser uma pessoa metódica, que saiba gerenciar seu pipeline de leads e seus follow-ups.
  • Resiliência e Proatividade: Perfil orientado a metas, que entenda que "não" faz parte do processo e que busque ativamente a conversão.

Diferenciais (O que nos fará brilhar os olhos)

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, pré-vendas ou em áreas comerciais com foco em agendamento.
  • Vivência anterior no setor de saúde, estética, bem-estar ou academias.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for API Designer / Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will : (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer / Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer‑centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.

API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.

Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).

Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early‑stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.

API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.

Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.

API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.

Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.

Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth / OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.

Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.

Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.

Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer‑first design principles.

Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.

Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.

Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer‑friendly documentation and API identity cards.

Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool.

title: Technician, Platform Operations Rio
description:
Technician, Platform Operations Rio

SES provides broadband platform solutions across a diverse range of satellite services, including aviation, maritime, cellular backhaul, and enterprise networking. As part of this role, the team member will be expected to support SES customers operating within these specialized environments and elevate issues to appropriate internal or external teams as needed. When required, this individual will coordinate and facilitate troubleshooting sessions involving SES customers, technology partners, and vendors to ensure timely resolution and service continuity.

The NOC Technician role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment responding to emails and answering phone calls to support satellite and IP‑based broadband platform offerings. The ideal candidate will be familiar with the demands and expectations of working in an operations center and will be knowledgeable of radio frequency (RF) and satellite broadband platforms technology.

This team member will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving service issues across a global network of terminals and will work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met.

The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base and requires strong communication skills, with a customer‑first mindset. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portuguese, English and Spanish
  • Perform triage and troubleshooting of service interruptions, alarms, and performance issues across satellite and IP‑based platforms.
  • Monitor and manage full‑time services and teleport RF‑based hub equipment.
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue
  • Ensure compliance with SES standards practices and processes
  • Execute change management activities in accordance with ITIL standards.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, changes, and resolutions.
  • Incorporate and leverage industry best practices while maintaining alignment with Intelsat goals and capabilities
  • Must be able to maintain customer privacy in compliance with all applicable laws
  • Able to successfully navigate and use Microsoft Office Suite products
  • Manage positive relationships with customers to ensure customer retention
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be able to meet set expectations for call center metrics and customer turnaround times
  • Escalate customer reported technical service issues or requests to the appropriate NOC vertical team
  • Maintain accurate information and data in appropriate systems by tracking and capturing information and data
  • Ability to operate in a team environment cross functionally where employees constantly provide support to each other
  • Flexible and adaptive to change

COMPETENCIES

  • Customer communications – serves as the primary liaison for SES customers, ensuring clear, professional, and proactive communications
  • Language skills – Provides multilingual support in Portuguese, English, and Spanish
  • Technical acumen – Strong understanding of satellite RF systems, IP networking, and broadband platforms (e.g., Gilat SkyEdge).
  • Problem solving – Demonstrated ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues independently and under pressure.
  • Team collaboration – Works closely with multiple NOC technical verticals, vendors and customers to coordinate support efforts
  • Adaptability – Thrives in a dynamic, shift‑based environment and embraces change with a positive attitude.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish
  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in satellite communications and IP‑based broadband platforms
  • 1-2 years proven customer service including relevant experience or equivalent education experience
  • Familiarity with RF theory and network management systems.
  • High aptitude for Networking and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with RF theory and network management systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Possess problem analysis and problem resolution skills
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical documentation and equipment manuals
  • Must be available to work rotating shifts

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • Experience working with Network Operation Centers is a plus
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Juniper/Cisco environments, and API‑based tools is a plus.

description:
Do you believe that technology can revolutionize quality management?

Would you like to be part of projects that drive quality through digital innovation?

Role Summary:

As a Quality Specialist – Data Management, you will be responsible for designing and implementing data solutions that empower the Quality Hub, an interconnected ecosystem of tools focused on quality management. Your challenge will be to ensure reliable, scalable, and high‑quality data pipelines and models that support analytics, dashboards, Power Apps, and future AI applications. Working closely with the Quality Specialist – Digital Tools and other stakeholders, you will contribute to transforming quality processes through data‑driven innovation, generating real impact on operations and business decisions.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Data Engineering: Develop automated processes to acquire and consolidate data from ERP (Oracle), quality systems, and internal tools; build efficient ETL/ELT pipelines and data models; and ensure data integrity and governance to enable analytics, AI readiness, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Data Strategy and Architecture: Define and maintain the overall data architecture strategy for the Quality Hub, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enabling scalability, integration, and readiness for advanced analytics and AI solutions.
  • Systems Integration: Ensure connectivity between different tools in the quality ecosystem, promoting automation and efficiency.
  • Interface with Stakeholders: Work together with quality, IT, engineering and other areas teams to understand needs, define requirements, and prioritize projects.
  • Development and Customization: Work on the evolution of existing tools and the specification of new digital solutions.
  • Change Management: Promote the adoption of digital tools, offering training and support for users.
  • Monitoring and Continuous Improvement: Monitor performance indicators of the tools and implement improvements to increase efficiency and usability.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields.
  • Experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, and data modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python; familiarity with big data tools and cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of data governance and quality frameworks.
  • Experience integrating ERP systems (Oracle) and industrial software.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI), automation platforms (Power Automate) and low code apps (Power App).
  • Understanding of machine learning workflows and AI readiness.
  • Advanced English for global communication.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Analytical and detail‑oriented profile.
  • Ability to design scalable and efficient data architectures.
  • Clear and effective communication to deal with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proactivity and self‑management ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Creativity to propose innovative solutions within the digital quality ecosystem.

description:
Senior Partnership Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day‑to‑day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on‑time, in‑scope, and on‑budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA‑related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third‑party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • 6–8 years of experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in or with international organizations and global brands
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market and local executional landscape is a strong asset
  • Client‑oriented with strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Efficient and effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to define priorities, lead projects independently, and provide direction to junior team members when required
  • Team‑oriented, service‑minded, and collaborative across functions
  • Strategic and creative problem‑solver with a hands‑on mindset
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Banco de Talentos

Não encontrou uma vaga para você? Cadastre seu currículo aqui e venha fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos !

Falando sobre o Flamengo...

Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros.

Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil!

O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).

In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.

No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.

To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.

Like what you see? Apply now!

WHAT YOU'LL DO :

Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.

Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.

Design : You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.

Development : You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.

Learning Outcomes : You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.

Continuous Learner : You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside‑in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE :

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and / or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart :

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English‑speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload / manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN :

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission‑driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands‑on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CultSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual,Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um.Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus.Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Na Artefact LatAm, acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura baseada na empatia!

Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque empatia é para todos, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos mentes e corações incríveis ao nosso lado! Venha ser Artefact!

Sobre a Área

O time de Staffing é o coração operacional da Artefact na América Latina, responsável por garantir que as nossas equipes estejam na configuração certa, no momento certo, para impulsionar o crescimento dos nossos clientes e da própria consultoria.

Somos o elo entre as lideranças, os gerentes de projeto e os times internos, planejando a capacidade operacional, acompanhando a dinâmica de alocação e promovendo uma experiência de excelência para todos os stakeholders, locais e globais.

Nosso dia a dia é intenso e diverso : combina análise, planejamento, relacionamento e inovação. A área está em plena expansão e oferece grande visibilidade dentro da organização, com exposição direta a diretores, sócios e times internacionais.

O que você fará

Como Analista de Operações, você será peça-chave na estruturação e evolução do time de Staffing LATAM.

Vai atuar lado a lado com lideranças e gerentes de projeto para antecipar necessidades, otimizar o uso da capacidade regional e apoiar decisões estratégicas de alocação de talentos.

Você também terá papel ativo na transformação da área, puxando iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação e padronização de práticas que sustentem o crescimento acelerado da Artefact na região.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de entender o funcionamento da operação da empresa como um todo, desde o planejamento de capacidade até a tomada de decisão estratégica sobre alocações e demandas futuras.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar gerentes e diretores na análise de capacidade e planejamento operacional dos times de projeto;

  • Criar relatórios, painéis e análises que tragam visibilidade e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar em projetos de inovação e automação dos processos de staffing e operações internas;
  • Contribuir para a excelência da experiência dos stakeholders internos e globais, mantendo uma comunicação clara, estruturada e colaborativa;

Garantir a segurança da informação, políticas de acesso e conformidade com as normas internas.

Participar ativamente da evolução de uma área em fase de estruturação, com oportunidades reais de aprendizado e impacto.

Qualificações e Habilidades

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Administração, Engenharias, Economia, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Organização excepcional e atenção a detalhes — essenciais para atuar com alta exposição e múltiplas prioridades;

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.

  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.

  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
At BrainBuffet, we create fun, real-world courses that help students learn creative software and earn certifications. We're looking for a Learning Experience Designer — someone who bridges education and creativity. You'll make sure our courses don't just teach students, but truly engage them.

This role is perfect for someone who loves to blend instructional design, storytelling, and visual creativity — ensuring that every BrainBuffet course feels dynamic, clear, and unforgettable.

If you love spotting small details that make a big difference - from pacing and clarity to those moments where an animation or callout could make content "click" - this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Content Development

Review courses at all stages of production (pre-production, production, post-production) to ensure accuracy, clarity, engagement, and pedagogical alignment.

Ensure content design is grounded in evidence-based learning science, instructional strategies, accessibility, and usability principles.

Share thoughtful suggestions with editors, animators, designers and the Creative Director to improve pacing, flow, and visual engagement in ways that support learning outcomes.

Identify and address content gaps, redundancies, or inconsistencies, always considering how pedagogical connections can be strengthened for students.

Review written materials (lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes, and scripts) to ensure they align with learning goals and reinforce the course's instructional design.

Creative Review

Watch and analyze video lessons through the student's eyes — how can we make this click better?

Suggest creative ideas for editors, such as:

  • On-screen callouts to reinforce key terms
  • Animations or zoom‑ins to maintain interest
  • Moments of humor, visuals, or transitions that break monotony

Ensure creative elements enhance, rather than distract from learning.

Work closely with the video and design teams to bring educational content to life — visually and conceptually.

Ensure creative ideas always serve the learning experience, not just the visuals.

Collaborate with the Learning Designer to keep BrainBuffet's courses interactive, fun, and student-centered.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Strong background in education, instructional design, or curriculum development.
  • Experience creating or reviewing digital learning content (video-based or e-learning).
  • Excellent eye for detail, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to give clear, positive, and constructive creative feedback.
  • Comfortable collaborating with multiple teams (education, editing, design).

Nice to have

  • Background in media production or creative direction.
  • Familiarity with certification-based learning or software like Adobe, Autodesk, or Microsoft.
  • Experience balancing educational objectives with engaging, visual storytelling.

Soft Skills We Value at BrainBuffet

  • Team players who thrive in collaborative environments and believe the best ideas come from working together.
  • People who value continuous learning and teaching, understanding that growth is a constant part of this role.
  • Respectful communicators who listen deeply and approach feedback with empathy and clarity.
  • Individuals who work with purpose and feel genuinely passionate about education, student success, and making learning meaningful.
  • A positive, solutions-oriented mindset — someone who can navigate challenges with creativity and calm.

If you're passionate about making learning fun and meaningful, we'd love to meet you.

Apply now and bring your creative spark to the BrainBuffet team!

Next steps

Write an email to with a cover letter that elaborates why you think you are a good fit for this role. Please include your resume and any relevant portfolio you might want to share with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

Quem somos nós?

A Strattner é uma empresa familiar e brasileira que atua no mercado médico hospitalar desde 1950. Vamos além da tradição. Somos transformação, conhecimento, compartilhamento e dedicação.

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL / ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI / CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex. : PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake / lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI / CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub / Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.
